The '''DL-12 heavy blaster pistol''' was a model of [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] that was slightly more powerful than a standard heavy [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]. At some point, the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] brothers [[Irol Faunor|Irol]] and [[Nevo Faunor]] each carried a DL-12 heavy [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Krykas V]] while attempting to collect a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on [[Min Erethen]], a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] and [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] designer who was stranded on the world.<ref name="Bloodhawk" />

{{RPG}}
The Faunor brothers had their DL-12s when they and their hired men were defeated by another group of individuals who reached Erethen first.<ref name="Bloodhawk" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
The DL-12 heavy blaster [[Pistol/Legends|pistol]] was created for "[[Bloodhawk Down]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Owen K.C. Stephens]] for the [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Revised Core Rulebook|revised edition]] of [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was posted on [[Wizards.com]] on [[October 10]], [[2002]]. The adventure is intended to be usable in any era, and upon finding that Min Erethen has been reached by the players, whether the Faunors use their DL-12 heavy blaster pistols or their [[LaserHone/Legends|LaserHone]] [[Duelist vibrorapier]]s is up to the gamemaster; a successful encounter involves either the Faunor brothers retreating or being [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the player characters.<ref name="Bloodhawk" />

The "DL" designation was present on a number of other blasters produced by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], including the [[DL-18 Blaster Pistol]] and the [[DL-44 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DL-44 heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="AAEG">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''</ref> The weapon was statistically identical<ref name="Bloodhawk" /> to the [[DT-12 heavy blaster pistol/Legends|DT-12 heavy blaster pistol]], an item included in the ''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]''<ref name="AAEG" />&mdash;the accompanying [[October]] 2002 roleplaying sourcebook to "Bloodhawk Down."<ref name="Bloodhawk" />
